ClassRoster.title: ClassRoster
ClassRoster.description: A school class roster created and managed by the authenticated teacher, containing the grade level, class name, and list of enrolled student names.

teacherUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the authenticated teacher who created this class.

students.description: Bounded list (1 to 60) of student full names in this class.

isActive.description: Whether this class is active and selectable by students.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the class roster was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the class roster was last updated.

StudentSubmission.title: StudentSubmission
StudentSubmission.description: A challenge submission submitted by a student (no login required) verified against an active teacher-created ClassRoster. Contains zero PII.

classId.description: Document ID of the parent ClassRoster in /classes/{classId}.

className.description: Class name matching the parent ClassRoster.

grade.description: Grade level (6 to 9) matching the parent ClassRoster.

studentName.description: Student full name verified against the parent ClassRoster.students list.

correctCount.description: Number of unique challenges answered correctly (0 to 200).

bestStreak.description: Best consecutive correct answer streak (0 to 200).

durationSec.description: Total time spent completing the challenge in seconds (1 to 7200).

completedSections.description: Bounded list of completed challenge sections (dragdrop, shape, quiz, function, custom).

isPublic.description: Whether this submission is visible on class and grade leaderboards.

submittedAt.description: Server timestamp when the student submitted their answers.

QuestionType.title: QuestionType
QuestionType.description: A teacher-created custom question category/type displayed as an additional stage in the Student Challenge.

teacherUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the teacher who created this question type.

title.description: Display title of the question category (e.g., Đúng / Sai, Vai trò của vi khuẩn).

description.description: Short guidance or description shown to students.

format.description: Answer interaction format for questions in this category.

pointsPerQuestion.description: Default score awarded per correct question in this category (5 to 50).

isActive.description: Whether this category is visible to students in the Challenge.

CustomQuestion.title: CustomQuestion
CustomQuestion.description: A teacher-authored question belonging to either the built-in quiz category or a custom QuestionType.

teacherUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the teacher who created this question.

categoryId.description: Category ID ('quiz' for built-in multiple choice or a QuestionType document ID).

question.description: Question prompt text shown to students.

options.description: Bounded list of 2 to 4 answer choice strings.

correctIndex.description: Zero-based index of the correct answer in options (0 to 3).

hint.description: Optional hint displayed when a student answers incorrectly.

explanation.description: Optional explanation displayed when a student answers correctly.

points.description: Score awarded for answering this question correctly (5 to 50).

isActive.description: Whether this question is active and shown to students.

AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Locked legacy registry; single-account teacher authorization is enforced strictly via verified Gmail.

/classes/{classId}.description: Active class rosters created by the teacher; readable by students to pick their class and name.

/submissions/{submissionId}.description: Student challenge submissions verified against an active ClassRoster.

/question_types/{typeId}.description: Teacher-created custom question categories readable by students in the Challenge.

/questions/{questionId}.description: Teacher-created custom questions readable by students in the Challenge.
